answer: Trellis beacon-decay bond: identities lock 60 credits on a trellis, dropping 6 per idle epoch. A beacon samples identities at random; a sampled agent shows a quill-signed proof with its opal seal; a copied or stale proof burns the bond. A rented-refresh ring fails: the beacon matches quill and seal to filer. First filing 25, then 4 more each; 1,000 fakes cost 2,023,000 for a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 25 once, filing one proof per epoch.
